reported_success.quote:
the replication undertaken here did not find any significant RB effects, neither as a
main effect nor within either word or nonword groups.

notes: Original primary source unavailable: DOI landing page returned 403; OpenAlex no OA location; primary-paper search did not locate a free full original source. Secondary quotations in replication reports not used for original statistic fields. Replication extraction is independent. The table statistic F(1,34)=24.61 is the lexicality main effect, not the repetition-blindness condition effect; the narrative verdict describes failure of RB and must not be inferred from this significant lexicality test.
